pages.text: A few helpers explain the pack for you: JEI, Create Ponder, Jade, Engineer's Goggles, the Xaero maps and AppleSkin. Learn these first and you rarely need a web wiki.

$(bold)JEI$(), Just Enough Items, lists every item and recipe. Hover an item and press $(bold)R$() for how to make it, $(bold)U$() for what it is used in. Press $(bold)A$() on an item to bookmark it. Machine recipes (mixing, pressing, fan processing) appear here too.

pages.title: Engineer's Goggles
pages.text: Wear them to see stress, speed and extra info on kinetic machines, tanks and basins. See $(l:create_basics/stress)Stress$(/l).

$(bold)Create Ponder$(): hover over almost any Create item (in your inventory or JEI) and hold $(bold)W$(). An animated scene shows how it works. Many add-on mods use Ponder too.$(br2)Ponder is the first place to look for how a Create machine behaves, so these entries do not repeat every block.

$(bold)Jade$(): point at a block or mob and a small box names it, its mod, and extra details such as machine contents or crop growth.$(br2)$(bold)AppleSkin$(): food tooltips show hunger and saturation, and the hunger bar previews what a food will restore.

$(bold)Xaero's Minimap and World Map$() show where you are and what you have explored. Create add-ons put train and ship info on them. Map keys are listed under Options > Controls.$(br2)Waypoints, map tips and coordinates are covered in $(l:home/maps)Maps$(/l).

$(bold)Changed keys.$() The pack rebinds a few defaults; the rest keep their normal key. Check Options > Controls.$(br2)$(li)Backpack open: J$(br)$(li)Jetpack toggle: N$(br)$(li)Accessories screen: comma
$(li)Shader reload (Iris): F8$(br)$(li)Aether invisibility: =$(br)$(li)Supplementaries quiver: backtick$(br)$(li)Stock ticker (Mobile Packages): period$(br)$(li)Player networks: semicolon

$(li)Cataclysm abilities: Home, End, Insert, Delete$(br)$(li)Railways Navigator overlay options: backslash$(br2)A launcher may overwrite the file holding these when the pack updates, which resets them.
